name: Earth Anomaly Observatory
tagline: Monitor global earthquakes, storms, floods, wildfires, volcanoes, ice, and space weather in one live dashboard.
description: Earth Anomaly Observatory is a live Earth-systems monitoring app that unifies signals from authoritative public sources into a single operational dashboard. It highlights significant geophysical and climate-related events across earthquakes, storms, floods, wildfires, volcanoes, ice conditions, and space weather, then summarizes overall global activity with an anomaly index and AI-assisted situation assessment.
